claims.text: The tasks evaluated in the current work are similar to those in previous studies, as they involve comparing grammatical and ungrammatical sentences using language models.
Previous work utilized uni-directional language models, while the current work employs BERT models, which are trained on larger datasets and allow for bidirectional context.
